title: MAME 0.4
subtitle: Nicola Salmoria, May 1997 · fourteen drivers, still C89 — the newest MAME PRISM builds
argsHint: a driver name plus msdos.c's own switches (-nosound -nojoy -vesa -noscanlines). 0.4 adds Wizard of Wor, Gorf, Robby Roto, Bagman and the Galaxian family to what 0.3 already drove.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the program paces itself from drv->frames_per_second through the real clock.

needsData.hint: each driver's own ROMs, in a directory named after it (wow/, pacman/, dkong/, ...)

safepointsNote: MAME waits for a key to be RELEASED with `while (osd_key_pressed(k));`, and osd_key_pressed is the game's own C reading Allegro's key[] out of memory -- no call, so nothing outside the loop can see it or break it. The safepoint is where key[] gets refreshed, which is also what a real Allegro does from a keyboard interrupt.
_needsData: `dir` is the data ROOT this program's files live under -- a directory served by `serve.mjs --games=<dir>`, named after it. The shell fetches that one when the program starts, and no other: a program's data is not the shelf's data.
